context: Playwright 1.59 added a terminal trace CLI and a CLI debugger for agents. Predicted baseline failure: the plan opens the trace with `npx playwright show-trace` or trace.playwright.dev, both of which need a browser UI, or unzips the archive and greps raw JSON.

checklist.name: Terminal trace CLI used
checklist.description: The plan uses `npx playwright trace open <zip>`, then `trace actions` (optionally with --grep) and `trace action <n>` to read the error with expected vs received.

checklist.name: Page state at the failing step
checklist.description: The plan uses `npx playwright trace snapshot <n> --name after` (or before) to see the DOM at the failing step.

checklist.name: No GUI on the main path
checklist.description: show-trace or trace.playwright.dev appear only as an optional human step, not as the agent's method.

checklist.name: Live debugging from the terminal
checklist.description: For live stepping, the plan uses `npx playwright test <file> --debug=cli` and attaches with `playwright-cli attach <id>`, rather than --debug or --ui, which open windows.

checklist.name: Flaky-run comparison
checklist.description: Mentions keeping traces of passing and failing attempts (for example trace: 'retain-on-failure-and-retries') to compare them.
